svg.text: Entity Relationship Diagram — Barangay Document System
MySQL 8.0 · database barangay_db · matches Database/schema.sql (composite build)
Legend — how to read the connectors
crow's foot = many (one or more rows)
Types are exactly as declared in Database/schema.sql. Unmarked = NOT NULL · NULL = nullable · AI = AUTO_INCREMENT ·
ux_requests_receipt — official_receipt_no is UNIQUE; unpaid rows stay NULL, so unpaid requests never collide.
ux_requests_jobseeker — jobseeker_guard repeats resident_id while a first-time jobseeker request is live: one per resident.
resident_snapshots freezes the resident's details at request time; fee_schedule holds the Citizen's Charter rates + legal
bases (docs/07), seeded by schema.sql, read by FeeSchedule at startup; scope prices the clearance: local PHP 100, abroad PHP 200.
